items.title: Theodore Purnell Interview, 1961-02-03
items.q: After all that, when I get there, Max, you look at me.

ctx.x: I mean Tom? Tom, Tom, Tom.

That was your brother. That was a good band. Now when I was in California with that band, Alvin played first, I played second. Just the time he went away, I played first parts of the marches. And then it took sick. After that, I had to play one night. He played one night in the dance band. See? And I was doing pretty good. After the war was over, everybody go over there. I had enough points, because my age was way up there. See? I went over there. Three months past, I'm going to ask the man. So I'm going to get…
